name: Noiseless earth
summary: An earth connection specifically designated as low-noise, used for sensitive measurement and electronics references.
description: The noiseless or clean earth symbol identifies a connection to an earth that is kept free of noise from power circuits, usually an instrument earth bar connected to the main earthing system at a single point. It is drawn as an earth symbol enclosed in a circle or with a distinguishing mark.

A noiseless earth is not a separate earth electrode. Separate electrodes not bonded to the main earth create dangerous potential differences during faults. The symbol identifies the bar and its single-point connection, which the earthing diagram should show.
readingNotes: Find the single point where the clean earth joins the main earth.
Reject any isolated clean earth electrode.
drawingChecklist: Show the clean earth bar and its bond.
Keep power returns off the clean earth.
distinction: A noiseless earth is a dedicated low-noise bar bonded to the main earth; a functional earth is any earth used for operation rather than safety.
